images.title: The Architect Rises
images.prompt: Bone-and-silver reliquary style: carved ivory bone and tarnished silver relief with fine black crack lines, hard cool rim light on every ridge, painted like a 1970s fantasy paperback cover crossed with a cathedral reliquary. A vast near-black night sky fills the upper three quarters, crowded with abstract constellations: only thin straight white lines joining stars into irregular angular webs, no animals, no people, no pictures. At the centre of the sky a round dome-shaped swelling, as if the dark sky were a membrane pushed toward us from behind by something unseen, with fine cracks radiating from the swell; no figure, no face, no funnel, only the pressure. Far below, a thin curved rim of carved bone crosses the bottom of the frame; on it six very tiny elves stand in a row, backs to the viewer, each with a small dragon beside it, all looking up at the swell. A small open book with empty pages lies on the rim beside them. Cold white starlight only, no warm colour anywhere, blue-silver and ivory over near-black.
